blocks.x: Seismic candidate ranking reformulated — reservoir-scenario evaluation 12x faster and appraisal wells decided on ranked evidence
an oil & gas major whose exploration teams ranked prospects on experience and whose seismic backlog outran every workstation they owned. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.

The baseline cycle timed the backlog: full reservoir-scenario evaluation at 9 days per prospect, appraisal decisions made on the prospects that got compute rather than the ones that deserved it, and two dry wells the post-mortem blamed on optimism, not physics.
The evaluation formulation itself was the bottleneck — full-waveform inversion chained to scenario runs kept everything serial. Faster hardware moved the wall; it didn't remove it.

We reformulated before we promised hardware: the scenario pipeline decomposed into parallelizable stages with quantum-inspired optimization over the parameter search, validated against historical wells so the ranking beat the incumbent on known outcomes, and the evaluation service running reproducible studies geophysicists can audit parameter by parameter. The backlog now ranks by evidence, not by queue position.
